verdict.rationale: Postman documents spec-first design through Spec Hub for designing an API's structure (docs-16/38/54), plus linting and governance checks on API specifications via the CLI (docs-22/32). However, no evidence explicitly names the OpenAPI format or describes exporting a spec as OpenAPI, so only the design half of the story is documented. Missing for 10: explicit OpenAPI support in Spec Hub, a documented OpenAPI export capability, independent or hands-on corroboration.
